title: Synthetic Data Generation — GAN vs VAE vs CTGAN
summary: A comparative study on the Adult Income dataset that trains a GAN and a VAE from scratch in PyTorch and benchmarks them against CTGAN, evaluating all three via KS statistic, correlation similarity, and TSTR AUC for downstream ML utility. CTGAN is run through SDV's sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer as the production baseline against which the custom GAN and VAE are compared.
